        <name>OnSuccessValidateCSR</name>
        <preset/>
        <required_translations>[]</required_translations>
        <script><![CDATA[/**
 * @param {params} params
 * @param {api} params.api
 * @param {any} params.event
 * @param {any} params.imports
 * @param {ApiHelpers} params.helpers
 */
function handler({
    api,
    event,
    helpers,
    imports
}) {
 /**
     * Handles CSR validation response and updates alert state.
     * 
     * Parses the validation output, updates the alert to show success/failure,
     * and stores decoded CSR data in state on successful validation.
     * 
     * @param {Object} event - Event object containing validation response
     * @param {string|null} event.payload.data.output - JSON string of decoded CSR on success, falsy on failure
     */

    const validationOutput = event.payload.data.output;
    const isValidCsr = Boolean(validationOutput);

    // Determine alert properties based on validation result
    const status = isValidCsr ? 'positive' : 'critical';
    const content = isValidCsr ? 'Valid CSR' : 'Invalid CSR';

    // Update first alert item while preserving array structure and other properties
    const updatedAlert = [...api.state.validate_csr_alert];
    updatedAlert[0] = {
        ...updatedAlert[0],
        status,
        content
    };
    api.setState('validate_csr_alert', updatedAlert);

    // Store decoded CSR data on successful validation
    if (isValidCsr) {
        try {
            const decodedCsr = JSON.parse(validationOutput);
            api.setState('renew_payload', {
                ...api.state.renew_payload,
                csr_decoded: decodedCsr
            });
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('[handler] Failed to parse CSR validation output:', error.message);
        }
    }
}]]></script>
